name: reflex
description: Pre-execution risk gate and prompt injection guard for Codex CLI: judges every Bash command and subagent spawn before it runs, with local rules, an editable policy, optional TypeSafe Jev (System One) judgments, System 2 escalation and a human approval queue. Shadow mode by default, no API key needed.

interface.shortDescription: Pre-execution risk gate and prompt injection guard
interface.longDescription: Judges every Bash command and subagent spawn before it runs, and screens tool results and prompts for prompt injection. Local rules, shadow mode by default, no API key needed.
